units.rawText: Thanks to Lord Hesperus' valiant defense, most of our wounded have managed to withdraw from the frontlines and receive medical treatment. Currently, the Entropization of the Reverse Tower and Sacred Canon have been halted, and everyone's neural clouds are slowly returning to normal.

units.rawText: Some of our forces are back to being somewhat combat-ready, and they have traveled to various battlefields to inspect the conditions. However, we will need some time before we can organize a concerted counterattack.

units.rawText: It is more than the Reverse Tower that faces this existential threat. The Watchtowers and Firewalls that defend each Sector have fallen victim to malicious sabotage, and reports from each front state that the situation is dire.

units.rawText: We lost contact with them when the Sacred Canon was Entropized earlier. We've sent fresh forces over, but...

units.rawText: ...What should we do, Lady Angelus?
units.displayText: ...What should we do, Lady Angelus?

spans.text: ...What should we do, Lady Angelus?

units.rawText: She cannot give a satisfactory answer. Trying to console or encourage her would feel hollow in the face of their current predicament.
units.displayText: She cannot give a satisfactory answer. Trying to console or encourage her would feel hollow in the face of their current predicament.

spans.text: She cannot give a satisfactory answer. Trying to console or encourage her would feel hollow in the face of their current predicament.

units.rawText: It's not time to give up yet.
units.displayText: It's not time to give up yet.

spans.text: It's not time to give up yet.

units.rawText: That voice... Is that you, Professor?
units.displayText: That voice... Is that you, Professor?

spans.text: That voice... Is that you, Professor?

units.rawText: Angelus is briefly stunned, but soon she comes to her senses and realizes that the person before her is not a construct born of her longing.
units.displayText: Angelus is briefly stunned, but soon she comes to her senses and realizes that the person before her is not a construct born of her longing.

units.rawText: How did you get back from Tartarus so quickly?
units.displayText: How did you get back from Tartarus so quickly?

spans.text: How did you get back from Tartarus so quickly?

units.rawText: ...Uh, we had our ways.
units.displayText: ...Uh, we had our ways.

spans.text: ...Uh, we had our ways.

units.rawText: We received news of Hesperus' passing. He upheld his pledge to protect everyone to the very end.
units.displayText: We received news of Hesperus' passing. He upheld his pledge to protect everyone to the very end.

spans.text: We received news of Hesperus' passing. He upheld his pledge to protect everyone to the very end.

units.rawText: ...Yes, he did.
units.displayText: ...Yes, he did.

spans.text: ...Yes, he did.

units.rawText: His will has reached each and every Sanctifier. We are only standing here because the fire he lit has not gone out.
units.displayText: His will has reached each and every Sanctifier. We are only standing here because the fire he lit has not gone out.

spans.text: His will has reached each and every Sanctifier. We are only standing here because the fire he lit has not gone out.

units.rawText: Professor, how did things on your side go? Are the Sol and Sunna you mentioned in your transmission not with you?

spans.text: Professor, how did things on your side go? Are the Sol and Sunna you mentioned in your transmission not with you?

units.rawText: The Oasis is under a concentrated attack by the Entropics. Since the situation was urgent, we sent them there to provide backup.
units.displayText: The Oasis is under a concentrated attack by the Entropics. Since the situation was urgent, we sent them there to provide backup.

spans.text: The Oasis is under a concentrated attack by the Entropics. Since the situation was urgent, we sent them there to provide backup.

units.rawText: I gave the command, and as for the details... Ngh!
units.displayText: I gave the command, and as for the details... Ngh!

spans.text: I gave the command, and as for the details... Ngh!

units.rawText: Miss Persicaria, your wounds...
units.displayText: Miss Persicaria, your wounds...

spans.text: Miss Persicaria, your wounds...

units.rawText: It's alright, Eos. Your healing has helped a lot...
units.displayText: It's alright, Eos. Your healing has helped a lot...

spans.text: It's alright, Eos. Your healing has helped a lot...

units.rawText: Eos does not contest Persicaria's facade of strength and only escorts her to the table to join our discussion.
units.displayText: Eos does not contest Persicaria's facade of strength and only escorts her to the table to join our discussion.

spans.text: Eos does not contest Persicaria's facade of strength and only escorts her to the table to join our discussion.

units.rawText: It isn't just the Oasis; the sectors allied with us have also been focused on by the Entropics, and the forces that were supposed to reinforce us have been waylaid.
units.displayText: It isn't just the Oasis; the sectors allied with us have also been focused on by the Entropics, and the forces that were supposed to reinforce us have been waylaid.

units.displayText: Persicaria lowers her voice, and she speaks quietly so only the two of us can hear.

spans.text: Persicaria lowers her voice, and she speaks quietly so only the two of us can hear.

units.rawText: I tried to take control of the Entropics attacking the other Sectors, but while I managed to divert some of the Low-Order Entropics, there are still many Entropized Sanctifiers and High-Order Entropics obeying Eosphorus' commands.
units.displayText: I tried to take control of the Entropics attacking the other Sectors, but while I managed to divert some of the Low-Order Entropics, there are still many Entropized Sanctifiers and High-Order Entropics obeying Eosphorus' commands.

units.rawText: If only I had a better grasp of this power...
units.displayText: If only I had a better grasp of this power...

spans.text: If only I had a better grasp of this power...

units.rawText: The more you master it, the closer you'll be to being summoned back and imprisoned on the throne of Tartarus.
units.displayText: The more you master it, the closer you'll be to being summoned back and imprisoned on the throne of Tartarus.

still need you.

units.displayText: I grab Persicaria's cool hand. She looks me in the eye and nods.

spans.text: I grab Persicaria's cool hand. She looks me in the eye and nods.

units.rawText: Miss Persicaria, just what did you go through in Tartarus...
units.displayText: Miss Persicaria, just what did you go through in Tartarus...

spans.text: Miss Persicaria, just what did you go through in Tartarus...

units.rawText: Let's save that for later. Right now, Antonina and Professor Irida's situation takes precedence.
units.displayText: Let's save that for later. Right now, Antonina and Professor Irida's situation takes precedence.

units.rawText: Is Eosphorus still holding them in the Reverse Tower?
units.displayText: Is Eosphorus still holding them in the Reverse Tower?

spans.text: Is Eosphorus still holding them in the Reverse Tower?

units.rawText: That's right. The Reverse Tower was sealed after I left and no other agents have entered or left besides Eosphorus, so we can be sure that they're still in there.
units.displayText: That's right. The Reverse Tower was sealed after I left and no other agents have entered or left besides Eosphorus, so we can be sure that they're still in there.

spans.text: That's right. The Reverse Tower was sealed after I left and no other agents have entered or left besides Eosphorus, so we can be sure that they're still in there.

units.rawText: However, Eosphorus has concealed the situation inside the Reverse Tower, and we can't scan the interior for their signals to see where exactly they are.
units.displayText: However, Eosphorus has concealed the situation inside the Reverse Tower, and we can't scan the interior for their signals to see where exactly they are.

spans.text: However, Eosphorus has concealed the situation inside the Reverse Tower, and we can't scan the interior for their signals to see where exactly they are.

units.rawText: Eosphorus needs Irida's authorizations to open the passage and Antonina is still useful to him, so we can be sure that they'll be safe until the passage is open.
units.displayText: Eosphorus needs Irida's authorizations to open the passage and Antonina is still useful to him, so we can be sure that they'll be safe until the passage is open.

spans.text: Eosphorus needs Irida's authorizations to open the passage and Antonina is still useful to him, so we can be sure that they'll be safe until the passage is open.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, they're just as important to us. Only by finding Professor Irida and Antonina can we exert influence over the transfer passage to keep Eosphorus from heading to reality.

spans.text: Meanwhile, they're just as important to us. Only by finding Professor Irida and Antonina can we exert influence over the transfer passage to keep Eosphorus from heading to reality.

units.rawText: I understand. They helped cover my retreat before this, and just for that alone, I will do everything I can to help you with the rescue.
units.displayText: I understand. They helped cover my retreat before this, and just for that alone, I will do everything I can to help you with the rescue.

spans.text: I understand. They helped cover my retreat before this, and just for that alone, I will do everything I can to help you with the rescue.

units.rawText: According to the information you've obtained, the passage to reality will open in several hours. In order to verify this information, we have been observing the Magrasea-wide movements of the Entropic swarm.

units.rawText: That's...
units.displayText: That's...

units.displayText: De Lacey.

units.displayText: Guardian Squad has finished gathering at the Neural Cloud Sector as requested. We're ready to deploy at your command.

spans.text: Thank you, De Lacey. How is the Neural Cloud Sector doing?

units.rawText: ...Not good. There are more and more Entropics gathering here, and our signals are being disrupted by Entropization.
units.displayText: ...Not good. There are more and more Entropics gathering here, and our signals are being disrupted by Entropization.

spans.text: ...Not good. There are more and more Entropics gathering here, and our signals are being disrupted by Entropization.

units.rawText: Havi... I mean, Havoc and the others are trying to break into the Neural Cloud Sector by force, but the Entropics are just too strong. All we can do now is observe from the edge of the Sector.
units.displayText: Havi... I mean, Havoc and the others are trying to break into the Neural Cloud Sector by force, but the Entropics are just too strong. All we can do now is observe from the edge of the Sector.

spans.text: Havi... I mean, Havoc and the others are trying to break into the Neural Cloud Sector by force, but the Entropics are just too strong. All we can do now is observe from the edge of the Sector.

units.rawText: Yo, Professor! It's been a while...
units.displayText: Yo, Professor! It's been a while...

spans.text: Yo, Professor! It's been a while...

units.rawText: Havi, you're back... Ehhh?! Are you okay? You look really hurt...
units.displayText: Havi, you're back... Ehhh?! Are you okay? You look really hurt...

spans.text: Havi, you're back... Ehhh?! Are you okay? You look really hurt...

units.rawText: Well, I was going to just wrap things up in one go, but I ended up like this, so Hatsuchiri and the others forced me to come back for treatment...
units.displayText: Well, I was going to just wrap things up in one go, but I ended up like this, so Hatsuchiri and the others forced me to come back for treatment...

spans.text: Well, I was going to just wrap things up in one go, but I ended up like this, so Hatsuchiri and the others forced me to come back for treatment...

units.rawText: I haven't spoken to you in so long, and now that I've gotten the chance, I'm a total mess. Talk about having an egg on my face, huh, Professor?
units.displayText: I haven't spoken to you in so long, and now that I've gotten the chance, I'm a total mess. Talk about having an egg on my face, huh, Professor?

spans.text: I haven't spoken to you in so long, and now that I've gotten the chance, I'm a total mess. Talk about having an egg on my face, huh, Professor?

units.rawText: Havoc scratches her head as if all of this doesn't concern her at all. After a brief silence, she frowns a little.
units.displayText: Havoc scratches her head as if all of this doesn't concern her at all. After a brief silence, she frowns a little.

spans.text: Havoc scratches her head as if all of this doesn't concern her at all. After a brief silence, she frowns a little.

units.rawText: Professor, the Entropics that are already here are a real handful, and there are even more converging on this location.
units.displayText: Professor, the Entropics that are already here are a real handful, and there are even more converging on this location.

spans.text: Professor, the Entropics that are already here are a real handful, and there are even more converging on this location.

units.rawText: This isn't the kind of job you can complete easily, even if you're paying triple my salary.
units.displayText: This isn't the kind of job you can complete easily, even if you're paying triple my salary.

spans.text: This isn't the kind of job you can complete easily, even if you're paying triple my salary.

units.rawText: ...There's no point focusing on defense now. If we remain passive, we'll just end up being devoured.
units.displayText: ...There's no point focusing on defense now. If we remain passive, we'll just end up being devoured.

spans.text: ...There's no point focusing on defense now. If we remain passive, we'll just end up being devoured.

units.rawText: Havoc, could you please do your best to delay the Entropics? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida over here, we'll head over to help you ASAP.
units.displayText: Havoc, could you please do your best to delay the Entropics? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida over here, we'll head over to help you ASAP.

spans.text: Havoc, could you please do your best to delay the Entropics? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida over here, we'll head over to help you ASAP.

units.rawText: Alright then, I'll leave the Boss to you. Remember to pass on a message, I want a long vacation once all is said and done.
units.displayText: Alright then, I'll leave the Boss to you. Remember to pass on a message, I want a long vacation once all is said and done.

spans.text: Alright then, I'll leave the Boss to you. Remember to pass on a message, I want a long vacation once all is said and done.

units.displayText: Havoc waves to me before ending the transmission and returning to the battlefield.

units.rawText: As the glow of the transmission window fades, it's replaced by a red-colored countdown timer.

spans.text: As the glow of the transmission window fades, it's replaced by a red-colored countdown timer.

units.rawText: Only Antonina and Professor Irida have the authorizations to interfere with the passage... Eosphorus must have locked them up because he knew that.
units.displayText: Only Antonina and Professor Irida have the authorizations to interfere with the passage... Eosphorus must have locked them up because he knew that.

spans.text: Only Antonina and Professor Irida have the authorizations to interfere with the passage... Eosphorus must have locked them up because he knew that.

units.rawText: If we can't defeat Eosphorus in a straight fight as planned, we'll have to keep him from destroying Magrasea through indirect means.

units.rawText: By which you mean...?
units.displayText: By which you mean...?

units.displayText: I shake my head and cut Angelus off.

spans.text: I shake my head and cut Angelus off.

units.rawText: ...This is not the time to discuss our backup plan. Our current priority is to get into the Reverse Tower, rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, and ensure their authorizations aren't affected.
units.displayText: ...This is not the time to discuss our backup plan. Our current priority is to get into the Reverse Tower, rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, and ensure their authorizations aren't affected.

units.rawText: Angelus, how many Sanctifiers can you mobilize?
units.displayText: Angelus, how many Sanctifiers can you mobilize?

spans.text: Angelus, how many Sanctifiers can you mobilize?

units.rawText: Angelus bites her lip. She is clearly unhappy with the current state of affairs.
units.displayText: Angelus bites her lip. She is clearly unhappy with the current state of affairs.

spans.text: Angelus bites her lip. She is clearly unhappy with the current state of affairs.

units.rawText: ...About 40%. If we had an hour to de-Entropize our neural clouds, we could bring that number up by 10% or so.
units.displayText: ...About 40%. If we had an hour to de-Entropize our neural clouds, we could bring that number up by 10% or so.

spans.text: ...About 40%. If we had an hour to de-Entropize our neural clouds, we could bring that number up by 10% or so.

units.rawText: Fighting Eosphorus head-on in our current state is not a wise decision. Angelus, could you pull the frontlines back and provide cover to delay the Entropic hordes from the outside?

units.rawText: That isn't a problem, but when you say "from the outside"... Professor, are you going to enter the Reverse Tower?

units.rawText: Yes, that's the plan. The transfer passage authorizations are at hand, and we've lost our means of communicating with Antonina. There's no more time to hesitate.

units.rawText: We need to get into the tower ASAP and rescue both Professor Irida and Antonina.

units.rawText: In that case, I should go with you...
units.displayText: In that case, I should go with you...

units.rawText: My apologies. You're right, Love.
